statement: Original HypothesesH prime with its named base-change, polarized attachment, local classification, period and automorphic foundations. Inherited full endpoint proofs retain their recorded scope.
All eight original CohP fields; the local/global finiteness, duality, Euler, Greenberg-Wiles, normalized Poitou-Tate and tame-local inputs are neither weakened nor proved anew here.

The exact LocPAlt fields: Bernstein-Zelevinsky finite length/admissibility, geometric lemma, and the original tame-local theorem obtained from original local Tate duality. Their finite consumers are the bound full HTW endpoint.
Original local/global class-field foundations and Artin conventions; KX3 and CIP12 provide the exact reconstructed local-coordinate and every-map finite consumers.
Full original PfromAut, including arbitrary NiceE chains and P3core, is an explicit antecedent only of HIA3 equation HIA.8. It is not an input to HIA4 or HIA6 and is not declared completed.
Fixed-field theorem and cyclotomic action on primitive roots; their exact residual-quotient consumer is proved in HIA3.
